newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi man beheaded for shooting another national.
newsitem.headline: Saudi man beheaded for shooting another national.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Wednesday beheaded a Saudi man for fatally shooting another national after an argument inside the murderer's car, Saudi television said.
An Interior Ministry statement carried by the state-run television said the victim was killed by one bullet.
The beheading in the Saudi city of Taif near Mecca was the fifth execution in the kingdom this year.
The conservative kingdom enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, rapists, drug smugglers and other criminals.
